use: Heat reactions under pressurized gas (e.g. H₂), monitor pressure / gas uptake.
simulation: Gas phase as ideal gas, dissolution by Henry's law; hydrogenation etc. consume gas kinetically.
notes: Reference model profile: benchtop mini high-pressure reactor (Parr 4560 Mini Reactor class, 100 mL). Specs not individually verified (verified = false).
Mass-transfer coefficient kLa, heating power and heat loss are model assumptions.
sources: Parr 4560 series product literature (to be archived and checked)
H2 Henry constants: methanol ~3.8e-3 M/bar, water ~7.8e-4 M/bar (25 °C, order of magnitude)
to_calibrate: kLa at different stirring speeds (measured by sulfite oxidation or H2 pressure drop)

seal.description: Close and tighten the vessel head (headspace is 1 atm air); fill no more than 80 % of vessel volume

purge.description: Gas purge: pressurize to pressure (bar), vent to 1 atm, repeat `cycles` times (purge O2 with N2 before hydrogenation)

charge.description: Charge gas from the cylinder to total pressure (bar); with hold = 1 the regulator holds constant pressure and records gas consumption gas_uptake

close_supply.description: Close the gas supply (stop constant-pressure feed)

vent.description: Vent and open the vessel head (dissolved gas escapes); cool below 50 °C first
